keyword: will the artemis 2 land on the moon

verifications.claim: The Artemis II mission will not land on the moon.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'NASA's Artemis 2 mission is a historic test flight to send astronauts on a 10-day trip around the moon.'; R3: 'Today’s crew will not land on the moon—they won’t even orbit the moon. But they will... whip around the lunar far side'; R4: 'The Artemis II mission will not land on the moon but will instead circle it'; R6: 'astronauts prepared... to return to the moon, but this time, they will not land. Instead... fly past the moon'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources explicitly state no landing, only flyby or loop around moon.
